title: Ribbed shell roof with diagonal bracing
description_for_llm: Generates a ribbed shell roof: a two-way grid of vertical rib plates following a surface's U and V isocurves, with a pair of crossing diagonal braces on top of every bay. Inputs are all in the Rhino document's units (the upstream file was authored in metres: 16 x 10 bays, rib depth 1.8, brace radius 0.08, a 54 x 30 sample surface about 10 high). Give ALMOND_IN_BASE_SRF one single-face brep (a surface); polysurfaces fail because Iso Curve and Isotrim need one face. Omit it to build the stored sample roof. The axis outputs (rib isocurves, moved brace lines) are what validate_structure needs as members once sections are assigned with almond:section user text; the solid outputs are the drawn ribs (extrusions) and braces (pipes). Every geometry output is baked into the active document. The 2026-10-20 stress test took this roof (34 ribs, 320 braces, 764 exported members) through validate_structure in about a minute. Derived from the Almond parametric teaching definition 'structure-shell-roof-ribs' (Lucas Becker (runxel), runxel/grasshopper-examples @ 0e57586bdc, BlueOak-1.0.0); the geometric logic is unchanged, only the harness params were added (see ParametricLibrary/source-register.json).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_BASE_SRF
inputs.description: Roof surface as one single-face brep, in document units. Omit to use the sample surface stored in the file (54 x 30, about 10 high, authored in metres).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_RIBS_U
inputs.description: Number of rib bays along the surface's U direction (whole number; also the U isocurve count minus one).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_RIBS_V
inputs.description: Number of rib bays along the surface's V direction (whole number).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_RIB_DEPTH
inputs.description: Rib height: each isocurve is extruded straight up by this distance, and the braces sit at the top of the ribs.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_BRACE_RADIUS
inputs.description: Radius of the round diagonal braces (Pipe).

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_RIB_AXES
outputs.description: Rib centrelines: the U and V isocurves on the base surface, before extrusion. Members for validate_structure.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_BRACE_AXES
outputs.description: Brace centrelines: the two bay diagonals per bay, already moved up by the rib depth. Members for validate_structure.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_RIBS
outputs.description: The rib plates as extruded surfaces (U ribs, then V ribs).
